decisions.reason: Selecting dark purple for the website footer does not change the existing dark theme for website pages.
The source explicitly approves the footer color, not the landing-page background or broader visual direction, which already includes purple.
The footer color decision does not change whether header navigation is enabled.
The approved website-footer color does not necessarily alter the provisioning wizard's background or other styling values.
The token-sheet requirement remains unchanged; approval of a footer color does not modify the required token format or categories.
Footer color has no effect on the landing page's content, section order, or How It Works sequence.
Changing the footer background color does not alter the policy destinations, footer entry point, document format, or link behavior.
The source approves the website footer color and does not change the Cognito sign-in page's branding or background treatment.
The informational-page shell still requires a background and header logo; the source does not necessarily apply the purple footer to those pages.
The source's light/dark screenshots and monochrome-button observation do not establish a new Admin Workspace styling decision, while the purple-footer approval concerns the website footer.
The footer color decision does not change responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance.
Approval of the purple footer does not alter hero-text emphasis or hero presentation behavior.
